title: ConfluencePRDConverterConfig
description: Configuration schema for Confluence PRD Converter MCP Server and AI Agent Skill

url.description: Base URL of the Confluence instance (e.g. https://wiki.yourcompany.com)

pat.description: Personal Access Token or environment variable reference (e.g. ${CONFLUENCE_PAT})

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when connecting to Confluence

output.description: Output Markdown and asset resolution settings

default_path.description: Default output file path for generated Markdown

assets_folder.description: Default folder name for downloaded image assets

download_images.description: Automatically download image attachments during live page fetch

include_comments.description: Extract and append page discussions and user comments

formatting.description: Zero-loss DOM and AST formatting rules

preserve_nested_tables.description: Format nested subtables as compact single-line HTML to avoid breaking outer Markdown tables

filter_system_icons.description: Filter out small Confluence/Jira system icons (epic.svg, viewavatar, default.svg)

convert_callouts_to_alerts.description: Convert info/note/warning/tip panels into GitHub-style alert callouts (> [!NOTE])

jira_base_url.description: Fallback base URL for Jira issue links if not auto-detected

check_broken_tables.description: Verify table column counts and pipe formatting

check_missing_images.description: Verify that all referenced image assets exist locally

check_unescaped_tags.description: Check for unclosed or unescaped HTML/XML tags
